title: Product decision: resolver credit follows the signal-first display leader
status: OPEN — policy, not a code defect
rule: Do not change dominant_expert_for_learning until Joshua decides. PR #1303 documents the current behavior and is already on main.
observation: dominant_expert_for_learning() returns leading_expert_for_pick(), the signal-first display leader. Day selection uses selection_weights (Day Lens 1.05 / 0.90 / 1.08 / 1.05, then normalized) inside score_subnet_for_day. A momentum_shift signal can credit hype in the resolver while Day Lens selected dark_horse. That credit is what the learning loop trains, so this is a product-policy choice, not a UI caption.
decision_needed: Should Bayesian resolver credit stay on the signal-first display_leader, or credit the mathematical selection_weights contributor?
